Pearl Under 5th, a private bar from the team behind Tomo, is planned for 2027 beneath the 5th Avenue Theatre in the former Duke's Chowder House space. It is now under construction and inspired by Tokyo's referral bars. An exact opening date has not been announced.

Owner Anu Apte is planning an early 2027 opening for Little Gem in the former Independent Pizzeria space in Madison Park. She hopes to begin takeout in December, though no dates are set. Little Gem will offer the former pizzeria's pizzas plus wine and low-alcohol cocktails.
Independent Pizzeria closed October 16 after nearly 17 years. Its former owners are teaching their recipes to Little Gem, which leased the space.
Navy Strength, one of Anu Apte's ventures, closed on October 31, 2026. No other details are provided.
Vinnie's Wine Shop, one of Anu Apte's ventures, closed on October 31, 2026. Some of its staff are joining Little Gem.
